max_loss_limit_mode: starts at -$2,000, trails the end-of-day balance, enforced intraday including open positions; locks at $0 once the balance reaches +$2,000; set to $0 after a payout
assumptions: a payout is requested at the end of the first eligible day, for the largest allowed amount
the XFA starts trading the day after the Combine passes
a breached XFA is not reactivated (Back2Funded off by default); the bot starts a new Combine on the next day
the higher payout caps apply only when the $1,000 DLL was set at Combine purchase (limited-time offer, no end date stated)
the payout path is chosen at activation and never changes

unverified.scaling_plan_tiers: published only as a chart image; the text says a 50K XFA starts on a 2-lot (20 micros). Not binding below 20 micros; sizes above that are blocked
unverified.payout_cap_conflict: the XFA Parameters table shows $5,000/$6,000 (150K figures); the Payout Policy table by account size shows $2,000/$3,000 for 50K, used here

live_promotion: no automation in a Live Funded Account; promotion closes all XFAs, so a bot run ends there (not simulated)
